div.div: Tracing one sale. Steps 1 to 4 follow invoice SI-2025-007947 back through the Order-to-Cash tables. Step 5 uses the source-document trace to find its ledger postings, and step 6 classifies the revenue posting. A and B show the other postings the same sale creates.
